name: Sebastian Selman
role: Consulting Lead Switzerland, Clouds on Mars
tagline: Working at the seam between frontier technology and how organisations actually adopt it.
intro: I advise enterprises on the organisational side of AI adoption — the part that isn't the model. Before Clouds on Mars came ten years at Microsoft Switzerland as a Data & AI Specialist, co-developing analytics and AI solutions with strategic Swiss enterprise accounts. That decade taught me to read enterprise technology decisions from the inside.

I lecture at Swiss and German universities on organisational development, digital culture, and performance measurement for teams working alongside emerging technology. Most of what I'm thinking about right now sits under one heading: **Slaying Dragons with AI** — taking a goal-setting intervention that works for privileged students and asking whether it also works for people with far less room to fail.
publishing_note: Earlier essays and articles appear under my former publishing name, Sebastian Rappen.

career.note: Ten years — my longest role to date.
